software_core.title: Oral allulose after prior familiarization is associated with a distinct spatial c-FOS/NPY profile without detectable POMC or glial activation in mice: software and figure-reproduction package
software_core.description: Versioned scripts, environments, source tables, HIL-reviewed masks, publication graphics, thesis/manuscript deliverables, provenance, and the manifest-bound tooling needed to reconstruct the public Paper tree and reproduce all figures. This is an open mixed-license record: software code and software-support files are MIT licensed, while the authors' original documents and data are CC BY 4.0; the root LICENSE file defines the matrix. Figure 5 remains HIL-final but classifier-provisional as documented in the package.

main_figure_data.title: Oral allulose after prior familiarization is associated with a distinct spatial c-FOS/NPY profile without detectable POMC or glial activation in mice: main-figure source data (Figures 1–5)
main_figure_data.description: CC BY 4.0-licensed raw and acquisition-derived inputs used to reproduce Figures 1–5. This independently downloadable record is paired with the software core, supplementary-figure source-data, and Figure S3 full-resolution WSI records.

supplementary_figure_data.title: Oral allulose after prior familiarization is associated with a distinct spatial c-FOS/NPY profile without detectable POMC or glial activation in mice: supplementary-figure source data (Figures S1–S5)
supplementary_figure_data.description: CC BY 4.0-licensed raw and acquisition-derived inputs used to reproduce Figures S1–S5. For Figure S3, this record contains the matched L2 working-resolution exports, conversion receipts, aggregate SHA-256 manifests, and downstream analysis and QC outputs; the 24 full-resolution L0 BigTIFF exports are deposited separately in the dedicated Figure S3 WSI record. HistoPLUS phenotype labels are exploratory model-predicted outputs and are not validated mouse cell identities.

figs3_wsi.title: Oral allulose after prior familiarization is associated with a distinct spatial c-FOS/NPY profile without detectable POMC or glial activation in mice: Figure S3 full-resolution H&E whole-slide image exports
figs3_wsi.description: CC BY 4.0-licensed full-resolution scanner-native L0 BigTIFF exports for the 24 H&E whole-slide scans used to reproduce Figure S3; each scan contains mouse kidney, liver, and spleen tissue. This record contains only the 24 exact FigS3/exports/m26-NNN/1_L0_rgb.tif image exports (NNN 001–024). The linked supplementary-figure source-data record contains the matched L2 working-resolution exports, per-slide conversion receipts, aggregate SHA-256 manifests, and downstream analysis and QC outputs. The source MDS files are not redistributed. This record is one component of the mutually cross-linked four-record reproduction release.
